correctness.rationale: For equiangular n-gons, the equally spaced open vertex direction arcs of length pi−2pi/n have maximum common overlap r=floor((n−1)/2). Summation gives lower bound n/r; the cyclic consecutive-r block construction supplies an attaining fractional measure. If a measure is optimal, equality in n<=sum vertex masses<=r total mass=n forces tight vertices and each supported direction to hit exactly r vertices. Edge interiors follow from adjacent vertices. Independent rational incidence checks for n=3..30 corroborate the general exact double-counting argument; no reliance on finite sampling as proof.
residual_risks: Finite corroboration cannot replace all-parameter proof; source proof reconstructed from character/arc algebra.
